note: Festivals the city keeps, and when. Each `on` is one year's run: `start` and `end` bound the season, `peak` is the night it builds to, and the shelf appears `lead` days before `start`. A record joins with `"festival": "<id>"`; `match` words pull in the city feed's own listings by title. Read by the festival shelf in js/app.js. Dates that move (Diwali, Lunar New Year) are entered per year — check them each autumn.

items.name: Halloween
items.line: Haunted houses, block-long front-yard displays and the Castro's costumes.

items.name: Diwali
items.line: Lights, melas and fireworks across the South Bay and Fremont.

items.name: Thanksgiving
items.line: Turkey trots in the morning, and a quiet city by the afternoon.

items.name: Christmas
items.line: Union Square's tree, lights in the neighbourhoods and the holiday markets.

items.name: New Year's Eve
items.line: Fireworks over the Embarcadero at midnight.

items.name: Lunar New Year
items.line: Chinatown's parade is one of the largest outside Asia.
